subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Wanwen Bookhouse in Liyue Harbor
Ask Jifang about the travel guide

120000301.text: Feel free to take a look around, there's no obligation to buy.

120000302.text: We're looking for the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide. Do you have it in stock?

120000303.text: Sorry dear, we stopped stocking that a very long time ago. It just wasn't selling.

120000304.text: Huh!? But the Mondstadt volume was so interesting! Bummer...

120000305.text: The thing is, the author made it too personal, and the result wasn't really much of a guide.

120000306.text: It barely sold any copies, and the few travelers that did buy it made complaints afterward.

120000309.text: Well, that's a shame. The Mondstadt volume was a good read, even just as an adventurer's diary.

120000310.text: The fact remains that I don't have it in stock. If you must read it, try your luck at Chang the Ninth's place.

120000312.text: A book collector who lives in Qingce Village. He's a complete grouch — but he will behave himself if the conversation is about books.

120000313.text: He was a regular customer here back when he lived in Liyue Harbor, and I still send him the odd out-of-print book or two every now and then.

120000324.text: The place where he lives is difficult to get to. You need to head to the mountain just behind Qingce Village, then follow the wooden walkway all the way up...

120000315.text: Is there a chance that volume six of "Legend of the Shattered Halberd" is also in his collection?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Qingce Village and visit Chang the Ninth

120000501.text: *sigh* The heavens are smiting me... Smiting me to smithereens...

120000502.text: Excuse me, are you Chang the Ninth?

120000503.text: Uh-huh. And what do you want? Come on, spit it out!

120000504.text: We've heard you've got tons of old books lying around, and we wanna borrow the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide.

120000505.text: Hmph. Don't get me started on the topic of my books...

120000506.text: After the Chasm was sealed off, the family mining business started going south. Then, the Fatui started working to sabotage me...

120000507.text: To pay off my debts, I had no choice but to pawn off my beloved book collection. Every last book! Do you have any idea what that means!?

120000510.text: Wrong! That was my life's work! I devoted my entire life to curating, collecting, caring for them... And now they're gone! Gone, I tell you!

120000511.text: *sigh* It's useless ranting and raving at you like this. All I can do is try to save enough Mora to buy them back.

120000512.text: Unless you have other business here, I'm done talking to you. Goodbye! Off you go! Go on, go!

120000513.text: Please tell me that you didn't pawn volume six of Legend of the Shattered Halberd?

120000514.text: Legend of the Shattered Halberd... There's a title I haven't heard in a long time. You have good taste, my boy!

120000516.text: That work was an epoch-defining masterpiece. Granted, it was almost unknown at the time it was published...

120000517.text: But over time it was the work that came to define the genre of martial arts novels — and sparked a plethora of imitation works.

120000518.text: Barely any copies of the first edition were ever printed.

120000519.text: The later edition inexplicably went out of print almost as soon as it was released — a shame given what it allegedly added to the original story.

120000520.text: Yes! That's right, how did I forget? The original-edition sixth volume of that work is so rare, I could never bring myself to pawn it no matter how much I needed the money.

120000521.text: You mean— You mean you still have it!?

120000522.text: Yes. It is my one and only remaining treasure—

120000524.text: You've got some nerve keeping me and my boss waiting like this. I need an answer! Will you sell the Cor Lapis or not?

120000525.text: I'm sure you don't need me to remind you that if you mess with Gentry Maocai, you're messing with the Fatui!

120000527.text: But you know I can't afford to give a seventy percent discount on the price... I'd never be able to buy my collection back—

120000528.text: That's your business. The question is, do you want your books or do you want food on your plate? Perhaps you'd like to take your books with you to an early grave?

120000530.text: Whoa there, friend. Come on. This gentleman is either willing to make a deal or he's not. You can't force him to sell against his will.

120000531.text: Just who do you think you are? Keep your nose out of other people's business!

120000532.text: My liege, I am but one who comes to the aid of this gentleman in his moment of need. I am Xingqiu, disciple of the Guhua Clan.

120000534.text: "Guhua Clan"! Did you hear this clown? He thinks he's a Guhua master! In this day and age! Hahahahaha...

120000535.text: There was me thinking that the last granddads of Guhua had keeled over and died by now. Who are you supposed to be then, some sort of Guhua messiah!?

120000536.text: Justice is blind to our backgrounds, my friend. That just makes me someone trying to do the right thing. But you? The weasel who does the tiger's bidding may be less powerful than his master, but he is no less guilty.

120000537.text: Get a load of this guy! Just you wait, you'll be sorry you crossed me!

120000538.text: And you, Chang... you're selling that Cor Lapis whether you like it or not!

120000539.text: *sigh* Oh, how the wolves prey upon the fallen tiger! My days are numbered.

120000540.text: ...So just to come back to what we were talking about earlier, could I get a yea or nay about borrowing that book...?

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for Xingqiu after he left with the book

120000601.text: So you like reading, huh? Mr. Five-Second Hero?

120000602.text: Ho-ho, amazing... I NEVER saw that coming...

120000604.text: No wonder this book is so highly sought after...

120000607.text: How can they bully poor old Chang the Ninth like this, forcing him to sell his ore for dirt cheap? It's daylight robbery, pure and simple!

120001001.text: I thought that was just a regular pendant you were wearing, not a Vision!

120001002.text: You won this round, but you'd better watch your back! This isn't over!

120001022.text: Would it be too much to hope they've learned their lesson?

120001004.text: Yes, though I try to avoid using it. I dislike the unfair advantage it gives me against my opponents.

120001008.text: They've gone for now, but they'll be back looking to cause more trouble before long.

120001009.text: I'll see to it that no harm comes to those who show me kindness. There is a just and an unjust way to do business, and I will ensure the matter is resolved satisfactorily.

120001010.text: It's not like the Fatui to pick sides in a business dispute. But the confident demeanor of their errand boy suggests there is substance to his words...

120001011.text: There must be a deeper level of collusion at work here.

120001012.text: He mentioned Gentry Maocai. I know this name... he has a stately residence in Liyue Harbor. Maybe the two of you could go and investigate.

120001013.text: That idea works... But what are you gonna do?

120001014.text: Me? I have other things to look into. Let me see... Let us meet at Yujing Terrace in Liyue Harbor in a bit.

120001015.text: You really have stuff to do? Are you sure you're not just using us as your errand runners?

120001016.text: Wow... So that's how that turned out! This whole passage is just... extraordinary!

120001017.text: ARGH! This guy is SO ANNOYING! Paimon just wants to slap him right in his stupid face!

120001006.text: N—No, no you misunderstand. That fellow has a foul mouth to be sure, but his assessment of the state of the Guhua Clan is, well... not exactly incorrect, I suppose. *sigh*

120001007.text: Though I long to restore Guhua to its former glory, it is no easy task.

120000201.text: Wanwen Bookhouse... Guess this is where we go to buy books in Liyue.

120000202.text: Should we ask here if they have a copy of the Liyue volume of the Teyvat Travel Guide? It's super-duper interesting!

120004201.text: I've had my heart set on getting hold of a copy of Legend of the Shattered Halberd volume six for the longest time now.

120004202.text: Frankly, I'd be willing to do whatever it takes to get my hands on that book.

610045101.text: Hahaha, genius; pure genius! Perhaps a slightly unconventional take on chivalry, though...

610045102.text: He can't hear a single word we're saying...
